name: poll_draft
caption:
CHOOSE YOUR STARTER: DRAFT PICK 🎮🏀 We drafted all three of these guys. Which pick was the best one we ever made?

1️⃣ DeMar DeRozan, #9 pick in 2009: our all-time leading scorer
2️⃣ Pascal Siakam, #27 pick in 2016: 2019 Most Improved, 1 title
3️⃣ Scottie Barnes, #4 pick in 2021: 2022 Rookie of the Year, 23.5 PPG through 8 games this season

Comment 1, 2 or 3 👇

facts.claim: DeRozan: selected ninth overall (#9) by Toronto in the 2009 NBA draft; played for Toronto 2009-2018; the franchise's all-time leading scorer (#1); No. 10
DeRozan is #1 in Raptors career points (13296)
Siakam: 27th overall pick (#27) by Toronto in 2016; Toronto 2016-2024; NBA champion 2019 (1 title); Most Improved Player 2019; No. 43
Scottie Barnes: No. 4 for Toronto; 4th overall pick (#4) in 2021 by Toronto; Toronto Raptors 2021-present; NBA Rookie of the Year 2022
